title: Boundaries And Bonds Of The Chinese Diaspora: Empirical And Theoretical Studies
summary: This book encompasses three keynote chapters, six chapters in English, and six chapters in Chinese. The contributing authors hail from diverse regions including Asia, North and South Americas, Australia, and Europe.These chapters present a broad spectrum of perspectives on how the Chinese diaspora transcends boundaries and fosters interconnectedness. They offer a wealth of case studies, shedding light on diasporic Chinese ethnicity and networks from various angles. This interdisciplinary book is a valuable resource for readers interested in exploring the Chinese diaspora across different domains and aspects. It provides an insightful exploration of this topic and contributes to a deeper understanding of the Chinese diaspora's significance.本书包括三个主题章节、六个英文章节和六个中文章节。作者来自亚洲、北美洲、南美洲、澳大利亚和欧洲等区域。书中各章为读者提供了广阔的视野，思考离散华人是如何超越边界、构建联系纽带。它们提供了多样的案例研究并从不同视角来观察离散华人的社群和网络。任何对有关离散华人的各种课题感兴趣的读者，这本著作是必读之选。
